text:
Ana Torres: Yui at Kumo reported that several trial accounts didn’t receive the scheduled onboarding calendar invite — they got the confirmation page but no calendar attachment. Can we confirm scope and a customer message?
Marcus Lee: Thanks Ana. Any idea if this is email-only or calendar generation too?
Ana Torres: Looks email/calendar generation succeeded but our calendar service failed to attach the .ics due to a templating error when locale=ja. About 5 trial accounts in JP affected. No API breakage, just missing invites.
incident-bot: Incident OP-2026-47 created (calendar-attach-localization). Priority: P3.
Marcus Lee: OK. Draft comm for Kumo: acknowledge, reassure data/actions not lost, describe mitigation (resend with .ics + optional direct calendar invite link), and offer a 30-minute walkthrough and $150 credit since this affected activation. Keep tone friendly.
Ana Torres: Draft message: "Hi Yui 1 Thanks for flagging — your onboarding confirmation rendered but the calendar attachment failed to generate for Japanese locales. We’ve fixed the template and resent the localized calendar invites (attached .ics and direct links). We’ve also added a $150 credit and can schedule a 30-minute onboarding session if helpful. Reply here to confirm receipt or escalate to cs+oncall@redwood.com."
Yui (Kumo): Thanks. Could you also include the office-hours link for JST and invite my primary POC?
Ana Torres: Yes — will include POC and JST office hours. Marcus, please approve the credit and resend.
Marcus Lee: Approved. Also propose a short postmortem action: add an automated check that validates .ics generation across locales and include attachment verification in the pre-send job. Assign to eng-platform.
Ana Torres: Resend job queued for the 5 affected accounts. Command for ops: ./jobs/send_calendar --accounts kumo-11,aoi-2,sakai-4 --locale ja --attach-ics true --notify-cs=true
incident-bot: Resend job queued (job id: cal-2026-332).
Yui (Kumo): Received the resent invites and .ics attachments, thanks. Calendar shows scheduled session. Appreciate the quick fix.
Marcus Lee: Noted for renewal team: flag Kumo as handled and record $150 credit. Ana, please draft the brief RCA for customer thread: cause (template locale bug), mitigation (template fix + resend), next steps (locale test + attachment check), timeline.
Ana Torres: Will post RCA draft in 48h and schedule the 30-minute walkthrough. Closing loop: detection +5m, customer comm +15m, resend +30m, confirmation +40m, credit applied +45m. :white_check_mark:
